counterfactual_missing_items: No explicit raw span stating desmoplastic stromal invasion or single infiltrating tumor cells
Papillary architecture could overlap with other papillary breast neoplasms despite absence of myoepithelial markers
decisive_items: dilated ducts with broad papillary structures
densely packed tumor cells with moderately atypical nuclei
ER 90%, PR 90%, HER2 negative, Ki-67 20%, CK5/6 negative, E-cadherin positive, p63 negative, calponin negative, and GATA3 positive
response.rationale: R1 is anchored in definitive histologic and IHC evidence: papillary epithelial architecture, moderate nuclear atypia, hormone receptor positivity, HER2 negativity, GATA3 positivity, and absent myoepithelial markers. R2 relies only on nonspecific imaging features such as internal fluid levels and mixed cystic/solid echoes, which are compatible with many cystic breast malignancies and do not establish a specific tumor subtype.

rejected.why: Supported only by imaging findings of cystic/solid components and fluid levels; no histologic or IHC span confirms cystic hypersecretory carcinoma, and these imaging features are nonspecific.
